name: Desktop Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'packages/desktop/**'
      - '.github/workflows/desktop-release.yml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            artifact-name: clawdstrike-desktop-linux-x64
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            artifact-name: clawdstrike-desktop-macos-x64
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            artifact-name: clawdstrike-desktop-windows-x64

    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: packages/desktop/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: packages/desktop
        run: npm ci

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          cache: true

      - name: Build desktop app
        working-directory: packages/desktop
        run: |
          npm run build
          npm run package

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact-name }}
          path: packages/desktop/dist/

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts/

      - name: Create release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.sha }}
          name: Desktop Release ${{ github.sha }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            artifacts/**/*
